About
Incorporated in 2013, Aastha Spintex Ltd.
is engaged in the business of manufacturing
and trading of carded, combed and compact combed cotton yarns and cotton bales.

Key Points
Business Profile:
[1]
Aastha Spintex is a Gujarat-based textile company engaged in the manufacturing
and trading of 100% cotton yarn and cotton bales. It operates an integrated spinning
and ginning facility and caters exclusively
to the B2B segment, supplying textile manufacturers, fabric processors,
yarn exporters and bulk buyers.
